description: AERPAW at North Carolina State University publishes this experimental collection. This experiment records detailed cellular and throughput observations along UAV horizontal sweeps across a private AERPAW base station. A Samsung S23 using Keysight Nemo and a Samsung S21 using PawPrints provide complementary measurements. The source describes zigzag trajectories at different distances, channel rank, channel-quality indicators and iperf throughput, with CSV output. The current title establishes this experiment; the URL still contains an older semicircular-trajectory label. Coverage is limited to the described experimental campaign. Access links are supplied on the provider landing page. Licence, cost and access requirements remain uncertain for the linked release. Formats and variables are described by the provider; the files were not downloaded. Caveats include campaign-specific equipment and conditions, which limit transfer to other networks. Simulation use: Cellular radio and throughput model evaluation. Related records include the NSF PAWR testbed platform, which describes the wider experimental infrastructure.
